# GPnotebook

> > GPnotebook is a comprehensive, evidence-based clinical reference tool for primary care professionals, featuring NICE-guided protocols and medical education resources.

GPnotebook is an Oxford-based primary care reference platform providing clinicians with reliable, up-to-date clinical guidance across multiple medical specialties. The site integrates NICE guidance, diagnostic criteria, and medical education content to support evidence-based general practice.

## Key Topics

- NICE guidance
- Primary care
- Clinical diagnosis
- Medical reference
- Hypertension
- PCOS
- GORD
- Fibromyalgia syndrome
- Polycythaemia
- Diagnostic criteria
- Blood pressure management
- Clinical overview
- Healthcare professionals
- Medical education
- Evidence-based practice

- [Hyponatraemia – GPnotebook](https://gpnotebook.com/pages/diabetes-and-endocrinology/hyponatraemia): Hyponatraemia clinical diagnosis and patient management reference
- [PCOS – GPnotebook](https://gpnotebook.com/pages/gynaecology/pcos): PCOS diagnostic criteria, Rotterdam criteria, management overview
